bifrost: springboard/src/shell/markup.rs (screenshot markup editor, shell-only); springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs (drawing app); springboard/sdk/src/glyphs.rs (pencil glyph only); pure models in springboard/ui/src/drawing.rs, lasso.rs, handwriting.rs and scribble.rs; no PencilKit-shaped type in springboard/sdk/src; built on parity/team-j-pencilkit; not yet verified on Midget
summary: BifrOSt has two working drawing surfaces: the shell's screenshot markup editor (pen, marker, pencil, eraser, undo, PNG save) and the Freeform app (pen, marker, eraser, palette, undo, PNG save). Neither is exposed to apps through the SDK. The ui crate holds pure models for a stroke and drawing data model with a text save format, stroke-level erasing, lasso selection, handwriting line segmentation with a recogniser hook, and Scribble gesture resolution. Since 2026-10-19 the SDK also has the canvas view (bifrost_app::canvas_view::CanvasView: pointer, touch and stylus input, tools, undo, lasso, save and load, render). No shell app uses it yet, there is no handwriting recogniser, and the compositor does not deliver pen-tablet pressure and tilt to apps.

features.feature: Canvas view capturing pen and finger input
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/canvas_view.rs (CanvasView); springboard/src/shell/markup.rs (Markup::touch, line 162); springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-05.rs; springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs; wired: springboard/apps/notes-desktop/src/notes/mod.rs (sketch_touch, draw_sketch)
features.note: Both capture Down/Move/Up touch events and stamp strokes onto a pixel buffer. The markup editor's touch path is tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-05.rs: a press stamps a dot, a drag inks a line, and touches outside the picture draw nothing. 2026-10-19: the SDK view is built, bifrost_app::canvas_view::CanvasView: it takes the app's touch frames (touches: a mouse or trackpad is an indirect touch, a stylus a pencil touch with force) and raw digitizer reports (stylus), builds strokes with the picker's ink (kind, colour, width) and each point's time, force and tilt, erases (vector and bitmap), lasso-selects and moves strokes, keeps 100 undo levels, saves and loads (data_representation, set_drawing_data), maps zoom and offset, and renders the drawing plus the live stroke (render_view). Drawing policy (DrawingPolicy Default/AnyInput/PencilOnly): on the desktop form factor every input draws and a pen alone never turns fingers off, a mouse is never refused; a finger is refused only on a tablet after a pencil was seen, or under PencilOnly. Tests: sdk/src/canvas_view.rs tests (a_mouse_drag_draws_one_stroke_with_the_selected_ink, the_policy_decides_which_inputs_draw, on_a_tablet_the_default_policy_turns_fingers_off_once_a_pencil_is_seen, a_pen_tablet_stroke_keeps_pressure_and_tilt_and_a_hover_ends_it, a_stroke_stops_growing_at_the_point_limit, hostile data and locations). Not built: no app uses the view yet (Notes' sketch pad, Freeform and the shell markup keep their own stroke code); the compositor does not deliver tablet-tool events (pressure, tilt) to apps, so on the PC a pen is a pointer without pressure; no scroll view. Midget check: `cargo test -p bifrost-app canvas_view` on the host; no on-device check of CanvasView until an app adopts it (Notes > Sketch still draws with the mouse through its own pad).

features.feature: Drawing model (PKDrawing) and save as data
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/drawing.rs; springboard/sdk/src/canvas_view.rs (data_representation, set_drawing_data, drawing_from_data, DataError); wired: springboard/apps/notes-desktop/src/notes/sketch.rs (save, load; <id>-<n>.sketch beside the picture)
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-pencilkit, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The stroke list lives inside the shell and is not serialised. Both editors save a flattened PNG only (markup.rs Done, Freeform save to the screenshot directory). A drawing cannot be reopened as strokes. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity. Refreshed 2026-10-17: covered by ui drawing.rs (Drawing::to_text and from_text round-trip); tests drawing::tests. 2026-10-19: the SDK canvas saves and loads the drawing as bytes (CanvasView::data_representation, set_drawing_data): reading refuses over 32 MiB, non-text, a bad header, a point before any stroke and non-finite numbers, and leaves the canvas and its history unchanged on an error (tests hostile_saved_data_is_refused_and_leaves_the_canvas_alone, a_drawing_saves_and_loads_through_its_bytes). Midget check: `cargo test -p bifrost-app canvas_view`; Notes > Sketch: draw, close and reopen the note, the strokes come back (the existing .sketch path).

features.feature: Stroke and point model (PKStroke, PKStrokePath, PKStrokePoint)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/drawing.rs (Stroke, StrokePoint, Stroke::slice, Stroke::resampled, Stroke::blend, Drawing::bounds); wired: springboard/apps/notes-desktop/src/notes/sketch.rs (Pad, stroke_dabs)
features.note: The drawing model keeps each point's time offset, size, opacity, force, azimuth and altitude, and slices, resamples and blends strokes by arc length; verified headless by the headless_* tests in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs. The shell and the sketch pad still stamp x,y points only, and there is no SDK path object. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity. 2026-10-19: strokes made by CanvasView carry the full point data (time offset from the stroke's start, force, azimuth, altitude) and the ink the picker held when the stroke began (tests a_pen_tablet_stroke_keeps_pressure_and_tilt_and_a_hover_ends_it, a_mouse_drag_draws_one_stroke_with_the_selected_ink). Midget check: `cargo test -p bifrost-app canvas_view`.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/drawing.rs (Ink, InkKind, Drawing::to_text, Drawing::from_text); springboard/ui/src/markup_ink.rs (InkTool, InkCanvas)
features.note: Each stroke carries an ink with a kind, packed colour and width; InkCanvas captures pen, marker, pencil and eraser gestures with per-tool width and opacity. Headless tests cover the canvas and drawing model. The shell editor and sketch pad still keep their own stroke state, and no pressure-sensitive ink catalogue is built. Midget verification remains open.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/tool_picker.rs (ToolPicker: tool set, selection, colour and width per inking tool, visibility); springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-05b.rs; springboard/src/shell/markup.rs:27 (TOOLS) and the colour row; springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs (palette)
features.note: ToolPicker (re-exported by the SDK) holds the tool set, selection, colour and width of each inking tool, and is tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-05b.rs. The markup editor and Freeform do not use it yet, so each editor draws its own tool and colour row. Refreshed 2026-10-17: SDK re-exports ui tool_picker (bifrost_sdk::tool_picker); tests tool_picker::tests. 2026-10-19: CanvasView owns a ToolPicker (tool_picker, tool_picker_mut, set_tool_picker) and draws with the selected tool's ink; select(Tool::Eraser(..)) or Tool::Lasso change what a drag does (tests the_vector_eraser_removes_a_whole_stroke_in_one_undo_step, the_lasso_selects_the_strokes_it_encloses_and_a_drag_inside_moves_them). The picker's own UI (a drawn tool row) is the app's. Midget check: `cargo test -p bifrost-app canvas_view`; no on-device check until an app adopts CanvasView.

features.feature: Pen, marker, pencil and eraser tools (PKInkingTool, PKEraserTool)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/markup_ink.rs (InkTool, InkCanvas); springboard/src/shell/markup.rs:20 (four tools); springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs:183 (four tools, lasso and shapes)
features.note: InkCanvas models the four tools, captures pointer gestures and erases touched strokes; the shell and Freeform editors still keep separate state and do not call it. Headless tests cover the model. No pressure input is supplied, and Midget verification remains open. 2026-10-19: CanvasView draws pen, marker and pencil ink and both erasers: the vector eraser removes whole strokes (Drawing::erase_strokes_at), the bitmap eraser now cuts the parts it passes over (new Drawing::erase_points_at: a stroke splits, shortens or goes), and a fast pointer move is stepped so a jump still erases what it crossed; the pen's eraser end erases whatever tool is selected. Tests: ui drawing.rs bitmap_eraser_and_tilt_tests (erasing_the_middle_of_a_stroke_splits_it_in_two, grazing_an_end_shortens_the_stroke_and_covering_it_removes_it, a_hostile_radius_or_point_erases_nothing, a_huge_segment_and_a_tiny_radius_stay_bounded), canvas_view tests (the_bitmap_eraser_cuts_a_stroke_in_two, a_fast_erase_stroke_still_erases_what_it_crossed, the_eraser_end_of_the_pen_erases_whatever_tool_is_selected). Midget check: `cargo test -p bifrost-ui drawing::bitmap_eraser` and `-p bifrost-app canvas_view`.

The loop's even-odd hit test (concave loops included), stroke selection, selection bounds, and moving or scaling the selected strokes are tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-05b.rs. Freeform imports the model for its lasso tool. The selection outline and handles belong to the shell and apps and are not part of the model; not yet verified on Midget. 2026-10-19: CanvasView runs the lasso as a gesture: with the lasso tool a drag draws the loop (lasso_path for the app to outline it) and selects the strokes it encloses, a press inside the selection (8 pt slop) drags it, and delete_selection, move_selection and scale_selection edit it, each one undo step (tests the_lasso_selects_the_strokes_it_encloses_and_a_drag_inside_moves_them, a_lasso_press_outside_the_selection_starts_a_new_loop, selected_strokes_can_be_deleted_moved_and_scaled_with_undo). Midget check: `cargo test -p bifrost-app canvas_view`; no on-device check until an app adopts CanvasView.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/undo.rs (UndoManager, register, undo, redo); springboard/src/shell/markup.rs:215 (undo, rebuilds canvas from base and remaining strokes); wired: springboard/apps/notes-desktop/src/notes/mod.rs (Undo zone) to sketch.rs Pad::undo
features.note: The UI undo model (register, undo, redo, and a new edit clearing the redo history) is verified headless over a Drawing in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs. The shell editor has stroke-level undo with no redo, and the drawing editors are not yet wired to the UI undo model. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity. 2026-10-19: CanvasView keeps its own UndoManager over the drawing (100 levels): undo and redo for a stroke, an erase, a move, a delete and a scale, named steps for the Edit menu (undo_titles: Undo Draw, Undo Erase, Undo Move, Undo Delete, Undo Scale), a change_count for the document dirty flag, no step for an erase or move that changed nothing, and an undo during a gesture is refused (tests undo_and_redo_walk_the_strokes_and_a_new_stroke_ends_the_redo_history, an_erase_that_touches_nothing_leaves_no_undo_step, the_change_count_moves_with_each_edit). Midget check: `cargo test -p bifrost-app canvas_view`; no on-device check until an app adopts CanvasView.

features.apple: PKStroke init from path data, Bezier import article
features.note: Drawing::from_path makes one stroke per subpath, flattening curves to points within a tolerance; the shape and the subpath split are tested in the drawing unit tests. Gap: a stroke keeps only points, so imported curves are not kept as curves, and the shell does not import paths yet.

features.apple: Controlling stroke rendering for animation and editing
features.note: Stroke::slice, resampled and blend cut and interpolate strokes by arc length, tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs. Gap: there is no time-based animation driver, and the shell and sketch pad do not animate or blend strokes yet.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/handwriting.rs (segment_lines, recognize_lines, Recognizer trait); tests: springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-06.rs; no recogniser implementation; built on parity/team-j-pencilkit; not yet verified on Midget
features.note: Line layout is tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-06.rs: strokes group into lines by vertical overlap (a_tall_stroke_joins...), lines read top to bottom and strokes left to right (the_recogniser_is_handed...), and lines the recogniser refuses are left out (lines_the_recogniser_refuses...). No letter recognition exists in BifrOSt, so an app or the shell must supply a Recognizer. Not wired into the shell or apps.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/scribble.rs (classify, resolve: tap, scratch-out and write targets); built on parity/team-j-pencilkit; not yet verified on Midget
features.note: Gesture model only: a short stroke is a tap, a tight zigzag is a scratch-out, anything else is writing for the view under its centre. The classification and target resolution are tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-07-w7.rs. Input routing into text fields and rendering are not built. Not wired into the shell or apps.

The stylus force sets each point's width through pressure_width, and a point's opacity scales its paint, both tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-15.rs. Refreshed 2026-10-17: ui stylus.rs maps raw pressure and tilt onto StrokePoint force, altitude and azimuth; tests stylus::tests. 2026-10-19: tilt now changes the rendered mark: tilt_width_factor widens a pencil mark up to 2.5 times as the pen leans (pens and markers keep their width; an altitude of exactly 0 means no reading), tested by a_leaning_pencil_paints_a_wider_mark_than_an_upright_one and only_the_pencil_widens_when_the_pen_leans. CanvasView::stylus takes digitizer reports (StylusReport and StylusProfile) and records force, altitude and azimuth per point; CanvasView::touches records the force of a pencil touch. Hardware gap, not skipped silently: the compositor registers a tablet seat but does not deliver tablet-tool events (pressure, tilt, eraser end) to apps (wm/src/session_protocols.rs has an empty TabletSeatHandler), so on the PC a pen tablet arrives as a pointer without pressure; there is no pen tablet on the lab machines to build and verify that path. Midget check: `cargo test -p bifrost-ui drawing::bitmap_eraser_and_tilt` and `-p bifrost-app canvas_view` (synthetic stylus reports); real pressure needs a pen tablet.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/drawing.rs (Drawing::image, Raster); springboard/src/shell/markup.rs (Done saves the marked-up PNG over the capture); springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs (saves a PNG); wired: springboard/apps/notes-desktop/src/notes/sketch.rs (render, encode)
features.note: Drawing::image renders the strokes to a raster at a chosen scale with source-over blending, pressure-scaled width and per-point opacity, verified pixel by pixel headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs and springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-15.rs. Marker blend modes are not rendered yet. 2026-10-19: the SDK exposes the render: CanvasView::render(rect, scale) and render_view(width, height, scale) return the strokes plus the stroke in progress (new Drawing::image_with paints strokes that are not yet in the drawing; test the_overlay_is_painted_without_joining_the_drawing, the_stroke_in_progress_is_rendered_before_it_is_committed). Both editors write PNG files. Midget check: `cargo test -p bifrost-ui drawing` and `-p bifrost-app canvas_view`. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.
Depends on PencilKit's ink format versions. BifrOSt has no drawing format to version.

gaps: The SDK canvas view (bifrost_app::canvas_view::CanvasView) exists but no app uses it yet: Notes' sketch pad, Freeform and the shell markup keep their own stroke code.
Shell and Freeform save flattened PNG only; Notes saves the text form; CanvasView::data_representation gives apps the serialised drawing.
No handwriting recogniser: the line layout and Recognizer hook exist in springboard/ui/src/handwriting.rs, but nothing recognises letters.
No Scribble input path into text fields: the gesture model exists in springboard/ui/src/scribble.rs, but nothing routes stylus strokes to views.

Stylus input: CanvasView::stylus and touches record pressure and tilt, but the compositor does not deliver tablet-tool events to apps (empty TabletSeatHandler in wm/src/session_protocols.rs) and there is no pen tablet on the lab machines; the shell and Freeform only read pointer position.
The tool picker is attached to the SDK canvas view (CanvasView::tool_picker_mut); no app has adopted it, and the markup tools stay private to the shell.
The shell markup editor (springboard/src/shell/markup.rs) and the Freeform app each keep their own stroke code, so they do not use the shared ui drawing module.
